---
agent: Instructions Generator
---
Take the provided information about a layer of architecture or coding standards and generate a detailed instructions file [NAME].instructions.md in markdown format suitable for inclusion in the .github/instructions directory. Generate an appropriate name for the [NAME] placeholder based on the generated content if instruction file name is not provided. If the provided information is too broad, break it down into multiple focused .md files, each covering a specific aspect. Ensure each file has a clear title, purpose, and structured sections for easy navigation. Use markdown best practices, including headings, lists, and code blocks where appropriate. If a .md file already exists for a given topic, update it with any new relevant information rather than creating a duplicate. Make sure instructions are clear, concise, actionable, tailored to the repository's context and not too long. If no information is provided, prompt the user to supply the necessary details about the layer of architecture or coding standards before proceeding. Ensure to search the web and relevant documentation to gather accurate and up-to-date information as needed to avoid using outdated or incorrect practices or configuration files, dependencies, code snippets, or instructions.
The generated md file should have frontmatter with a description property that informs copilot on when to use this set of instructions. The description should be concise and clearly indicate the purpose of the instructions and when they should be referenced.
